attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 3.12.1 cluster, created a payments vhost with a durable quorum queue ("orders") replicated across all three nodes, and an app_user account scoped to that vhost for publish/consume. Verified durability by publishing 3 durable messages, stopping node1 (simulating node loss), confirming quorum re-election to node2 with no message loss, and consuming all 3 messages successfully from node3. Restored node1 and confirmed full cluster health. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol for all three nodes (native `reboot`, boot_id changed on each, RabbitMQ auto-started, cluster and quorum queue verified healthy after each), and did a final live publish/consume test post-restarts to confirm the app account still works end-to-end.
